testcase.name: Scenario: Open a ribbon context menu while the panel selector is open: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/panel-visibility-snapshot/checkout/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:428:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open a ribbon context menu while the panel selector is open ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible ✔ And the direct panel selector is open ✔ When the user right-clicks the Options panel title ✔ Then the panel selector closes ✔ And the ribbon context menu opens ✔ And the context menu offers Ribbon Appearance, Show Panels, Customize User Commands, Undock Ribbon and Docking Positions ✔ And Show Panel Titles is checked ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the ribbon context menu closes ✔ And the Tools ribbon remains visible
